subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR require visible latest-head proof for the legacy no-code SQLite upgrade path before merge, or may maintainers accept the current source/tests plus narrative proof?
rationale: The code shape follows prior maintainer direction, but the PR changes persisted registry upgrade behavior and the remaining proof gap cannot be settled by static inspection alone for an external contributor PR.

options.title: Require legacy upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code diagnostics_json row rederives and Gateway/config validation proceeds.

options.title: Accept the current proof
options.body: Maintainership can explicitly accept the source proof, regression tests, and narrative table as sufficient while waiving the usual external real-behavior proof gate.

options.title: Move legacy handling out of runtime
options.body: Pause this PR and request a doctor or migration-owned cleanup if runtime invalidation for legacy no-code rows is not the desired compatibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Require legacy upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code diagnostics_json row rederives and Gateway/config validation proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc gave the concrete predecessor direction that this PR implements and has recent plugin registry ownership signals.
